description: Get what the user's recent meetings promised, both ways: what the user owes and what others owe them, from conversations and meeting notes recorded in the last 7 days unless you pass from/to, done ones and suggestions still waiting in Review included and marked; then the follow-up reminders that are due. Filter by a person involved. For what is owed, either way: get_my_day is one day (the user's promises due by it or undated, and every promise owed to them), list_tasks is every open commitment over any date range or person, and get_recent_commitments is what the last 7 days of meetings promised.

dateField.description: Which date from/to apply to: 'created' (when the task was recorded, the default) or 'due'.

from.description: Earliest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day, UTC) or an RFC 3339 time. Defaults to 7 days ago when neither from nor to is given.

person.description: Only tasks involving someone whose name contains this (case-insensitive): the other person, who you owe it to, the task text, or the conversation title.

to.description: Latest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day, UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

name: get_recent_commitments
